Summarise posterior item strengths

Source: R/fit.R
posterior_strength.Rd

Normalisation is applied separately to each retained draw before any posterior averaging. With the default reporting scale, a value of 2 means twice the arithmetic mean item strength in that draw. In a block model the mean is over items, so block sizes are respected. The BT win probability against a hypothetical item of mean strength is \(\theta_i/(1+\theta_i)\); thus \(\theta_i\) is the odds against that reference item in a draw. This is not an average win probability over the observed opponents.

Usage

posterior_strength(
  fit,
  summary = c("draws", "mean"),
  scale = c("relative", "share", "raw")
)

Arguments

fit

A simple BT/PL or item-SBM fit.

summary

Either "draws" or "mean".

scale

"relative" (default, arithmetic mean one), "share" (sum one), or "raw" (the strengths as stored by the sampler).

Value

A draws matrix or named posterior mean vector.

Examples

data <- as_bt_data(matrix(c(0, 3, 2, 0), 2, 2))
# A short run illustrates the interface; use longer runs for inference.
fit <- fit_model(data, bt_sbm_model(),
                 mcmc_control(iter = 60, warmup = 30, seed = 1))
posterior_strength(fit)
